oneLine: CivicState has product code, but investibility waits on paid conversion and delivery proof.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

adoption.note: Only operator merge upgrades authority; this artifact remains draft.

sourcesAndMethods: Read repo planning files: MASTER_PLAN.md, .planning/PROJECT.md, .planning/GENESIS.md, .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/ROADMAP.md, .planning/existing-state.md [evidence: repo files].
Read implementation files under apps/api, apps/web, apps/worker, packages/shared/prisma, and tests [evidence: repo files].
Used dispatch registry notes for watchlist/personal-research constraint [evidence: dispatch].
No network research used; external market claims are marked as assumptions.

evidenceSources.claim: original business model, scope, pricing, exclusions
data export/deletion route and schema mismatch risk

staleSignals: .planning/existing-state.md says zero application code exists, but current repo has app code [evidence: .planning/existing-state.md; apps/].
.planning/ROADMAP.md marks all four phases complete while .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md still marks many requirements pending [evidence: .planning/ROADMAP.md; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
Fleet project id says brooks-history while repo product identity says CivicState [evidence: dispatch; package.json].

honestyLabels.policy: Every quantitative business claim in BUSINESS.md is tagged [evidence: ...] or [assumption: ...]. Repo files are evidence only for repo assertions or implementation, not external market truth.
honestyLabels.externalClaims: No external market source was consulted in workspace-only mode.

currentThesis: CivicState is conditionally interesting if residents pay $5-$25 for researched constituent letters and if official coverage, citation quality, and government inbox deliverability clear repo-defined gates [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts; .planning/PROJECT.md]. It is not investible yet because production demand, revenue, deployment proof, legal review, and market validation are not evidenced [evidence: .planning/existing-state.md; dispatch registry notes].
shortThesis: AI civic-letter workflow exists in code; investibility waits on paid conversion, coverage, and deliverability proof.

thesisCurrent.label: watchlist personal/research asset
thesisCurrent.summary: CivicState has a real civic-letter implementation surface, but it is not yet a venture-ready business.
thesisCurrent.honesty: Repo evidence supports implementation breadth; market proof, legal review, and operating proof remain assumptions.

customerDefinition.primary: Individual US residents with specific civic concerns who need research, routing, drafting, and delivery handled for them [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; MASTER_PLAN.md].
customerDefinition.excluded: Legal filings, regulatory submissions, subscriptions, organization APIs, community features, certified mail, fax, and multilingual expansion are deferred or excluded [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md; .planning/GENESIS.md].

implemented: Express API routes exist for submissions, officials, payments, campaigns, admin, compliance, webhooks, and health [evidence: apps/api/src/index.ts].
BullMQ worker agents exist for classifier, researcher, drafter, delivery, treasury, and reconciliation [evidence: apps/worker/src/index.ts].

Prisma schema includes users, submissions, campaigns, letters, officials, payments, deliveries, ledger entries, audit logs, agent action logs, and jobs [evidence: packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma].
notProven: Official data coverage at validation thresholds [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Government inbox placement at validation thresholds [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

financials.marginFloor: 40% net margin floor after fees [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md].
financials.reserve: $1,500 Mercury reserve with $2,000 warning and $500 emergency thresholds [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
financials.proofScenario: 25 paid submissions/month x $15 blended price = $375 revenue; $18.75 variable cost at $0.75/submission; $223.75 contribution after $132.50 burn [assumption: arithmetic from repo prices and validation ladder].

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up validation ladder, not top-down TAM, because workspace-only mode has no external sources.
marketSizing.operatorProof: 300 paid submissions/year and $4,500 annual revenue [assumption: 25/month x 12 x $15].
marketSizing.localWedge: 3,000 paid submissions/year and $45,000 annual revenue [assumption: 250/month x 12 x $15].
marketSizing.nicheNational: 30,000 paid submissions/year and $450,000 annual revenue [assumption: 2,500/month x 12 x $15].

revenueModel: One-time paid letter packages at $5, $15, and $25; subscriptions removed from launch; organization/API revenue deferred [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts; MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
competition: Resistbot [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: current capabilities not externally verified].
Change.org [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: current product scope not externally verified].
LegalZoom [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: current product scope not externally verified].
Quorum and VoterVoice [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; assumption: current pricing/features not externally verified].
Manual constituent outreach [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: common free substitute].

goToMarket.primary: Organic search and opt-in public campaign pages are the planned flywheel [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; MASTER_PLAN.md].
goToMarket.constraint: Publisher/public campaign pages are deferred from launch scope, so SEO should not be claimed as active [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
goToMarket.next: Validate one geography and issue category before scaling [assumption: risk-reduction method].

holes.mitigation: Run checkout-enabled beta before acquisition spend.
holes.residualRisk: If conversion stays below 3%, the product may be a free utility or feature, not a company [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

holes.hole: Government inbox deliverability can break the core promise.
holes.mitigation: Domain warming, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Postmark monitoring, and bounce-rate pause logic.
holes.residualRisk: If inbox placement remains below 85%, refunds and reputational damage can overwhelm the unit economics [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].

holes.hole: Official coverage may be incomplete, especially local coverage.
holes.mitigation: Run ZIP-code sample audits before accepting broad user traffic.
holes.residualRisk: If coverage misses repo gates, the product cannot reliably promise routing [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/api/src/routes/officials.ts].

holes.hole: Legal-adjacent drafting and political speech create abuse, privacy, and liability risk.
holes.mitigation: Moderation, disclaimers, citation verification, human review, and operator/legal review.
holes.residualRisk: Disclaimers may not prevent user confusion or harmful outputs [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts; apps/worker/src/lib/legal/citation-verifier.ts].

holes.hole: Repository identity mismatch damages data-room credibility.
holes.mitigation: Operator must resolve `brooks-history` versus CivicState before pitch.
holes.residualRisk: Investors may interpret mismatch as poor controls [evidence: dispatch; package.json].

risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not fund paid acquisition, API expansion, certified mail, public coalition features, multi-language expansion, or multi-state scaling until paid conversion, official coverage, citation quality, legal review, and deliverability are measured [assumption: risk-first operating plan].

holes: No legal/compliance review evidence [evidence: dispatch registry notes].
Official lookup coverage remains unproven against repo thresholds [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
mitigations: Run checkout-enabled beta before acquisition spend [assumption: validation sequencing].
Run seeded deliverability tests before open launch [assumption: launch-readiness method].
Complete operator/counsel review of disclosures, opt-out, deletion, and letter framing [assumption: compliance readiness method].
Audit representative ZIP-code samples before broad traffic [assumption: coverage validation method].
residualRisks: Conversion below 3% would weaken the company thesis [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Inbox placement below 85% would break the paid-delivery promise [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
Political and legal-adjacent content can still trigger provider, user-trust, or liability issues [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md].
Local official data may remain too incomplete for a national promise [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

assumptionLedger.basis: Assumes 30% single, 40% three-pack, 30% full-spread using repo tiers [assumption: no live mix data].
High end of repo token-cost range [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
assumptionLedger.validation: Track agent token usage, Postmark cost, retries, and support burden.

assumptionLedger.assumption: One operator can manage launch exceptions
assumptionLedger.validation: Track flagged queue depth and oldest item age.

assumptionLedger.basis: Launch scope excludes certified mail and fax [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
assumptionLedger.validation: Measure .gov inbox placement, bounce rates, spam complaints, and official replies.

roadmapBuildableShape.nextWork: Contains 8 single-worker checkbox items mapped back to BUSINESS.md headings [evidence: ROADMAP.md].
